## Verdict
REVISE — Acceptance gates are sound, but targeting, persistence evidence and log containment remain underspecified.
## Critical gaps
Existing input tooling selects the largest PID-matching surface; keyboard injection does not verify focus. Require an unambiguous surface identity and matching keyboard focus before every input batch.
## Important improvements
Specify the real save/close controls and bounded acknowledgements; distinguish natural exit 0 from cleanup termination. Never launch process two before process one and its descendants have exited.
## Validation gaps
Require baseline→expected bytes before close, identical bytes after exit, and authoritative editor-content readback after reopen—not merely surface content or marker presence. Observer code must have no target-write path. Enforce live aggregate log limits despite unlimited FSIZE; missing/redirected fatal-log coverage must prevent PASS.
## Recommended revision
Pin fixture/runtime/tool identities; create isolated profile/document; establish exact surface/focus; edit/save and verify bytes; close naturally and verify bytes/exit; reopen/read back/close naturally; enforce deadlines, fatal/log gates, unchanged hashes and scoped cleanup throughout.
